text: The team will design something on the smartboard within the next thirty minutes.
Decisions establish the energy source as kinetic energy, a doubly curved case, rubber components, and an advanced chip to support display and audio.
The group will show the concept/design to management within thirty minutes.
Actions include saving the current board, ME and UI performing a product evaluation, ME preparing another presentation, and ME and UI creating a new page on the board and being creative.
Problems include unclear remaining-time popup timing/trigger and accessibility concerns from red LEDs for colorblind users, plus issues with copying to folders and PowerPoint usage.
